zh: 依赖关系构成一张有向图：前置模块指向依赖它的模块。当前可以编译的模块，就是所有前置都已编译、入度为 0 的模块。
用 Kahn 拓扑排序，但把普通队列换成最小堆，每次弹出当前可编译模块中字典序最小的那个，就满足题目的选择规则。
对每条依赖 [module, prerequisite] 建边 prerequisite→module，并给 module 的入度加一；把入度为 0 的模块全部放入堆；反复弹出最小者加入结果，把它指向的模块入度减一，减到 0 就入堆。结果数量少于 n 说明有环，输出 IMPOSSIBLE。
en: The dependencies form a directed graph in which each prerequisite points to the modules that depend on it. A module can be compiled now exactly when all its prerequisites are done, that is, when its in-degree is 0.

Run Kahn topological sort, but replace the plain queue with a min-heap so that each step pops the lexicographically smallest module that can currently be compiled, which is the selection rule required.

For each dependency [module, prerequisite], add an edge prerequisite -> module and increase the in-degree of module. Push all modules with in-degree 0 into the heap; repeatedly pop the smallest, append it to the result, and decrease the in-degree of its successors, pushing any that reach 0. If the result has fewer than n modules there is a cycle, so print IMPOSSIBLE.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Kahn topological sort, using a min-heap to decide which module to pick among those available at the same moment.

## Proof of Correctness

An in-degree that reaches zero means that all prerequisite dependencies are complete; taking the smallest available item at each step implements the lexicographic rule, and if the result has fewer than n items, a cycle exists.

## Complexity

O((n+m) log n) time, O(n+m) space.
